title: From scavenger to catalyst: the emerging role of chloride in peroxymonosulfate-based advanced oxidation processes
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,2480-2498
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00674K, Critical Review
P. V. Nidheesh, Kuldeep Kaur, R. G. Anukrishna, K. P. Prathish
